OFFICE OF THE SANGGUNIANG PANLALAWIGAN

Acts as the legislative branch of the provincial government, crafting policies and ordinances to support Biliran's development and welfare.

MISSION

To manage effectively and efficiently the legislative functions through the approval of resolutions, enactment of ordinances and appropriation of funds which is geared towards the delivery of basic services to the constituents of the Province.

The Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Biliran as the model of excellence in effective Local Legislation in Eastern Visayas.

Showing 1 to 5 of 5 entries
‹1›

 

Getting Here

Air-conditioned buses (Victory Liner, Florida Liner, etc.) bound for Cagayan Valley pass by the province. For independent motorists, take the North Luzon Expressway and exit at Sta. Rita. Nueva Vizcaya is accessible through the Cagayan Valley Road (Daang Maharlika) & is about 268 km north of Metro Manila (approximately 6-7 hrs of travel by land).

Alternative Route:

From NLEX, exit at SCTEX till you come to TPLEX. Exit at Victoria or Pura then head for San Jose City and Carranglan, Nueva Ecija until one reaches Sta. Fe, Nueva Vizcaya. Travel from Sta. Fe to the capital town of Bayombong is one(1 hour) only.

Via Air

Cauayan City Airport in Isabela is the nearest commercial airport to Nueva Vizcaya and is three hours by land. From the airport, one is highly recommended to hire services of a tourist van/ DOT accredited transport either the Nueva Vizcaya Transport Service Cooperative at 0906 268 0603 or the First Novo Vizcayano Travellers Cooperative at 0927 472 7417.

Getting Around

Public utility jeepneys ply the routes around the province. Tricycles are numerous in every town. Van/car rentals service are available with rates depending on the type vehicle used and the distance traveled.

Mandate

The Sangguniang Panlalawigan is the Legislative body of the Province. It is mandated to acquire a better perception of the problems of the citizenry and the community in general and to provide solutions therefore, through legislation, geared towards accelerating national growth and progress. The Sanggunian lays down policies under which the provincial government will operate.

Vision

By 2031, Pangasinan is the premier province of great opportunities, sustained socio-economic growth, and a place where one can experience life at its best.

Mission

We are committed to good governance.
To serve with love and compassion.
To perform our mandate with excellence, dynamism, and innovation.
We are bound together by this sense of mission.

Key Responsibilities

The Sangguniang Panlalawigan in pursuance to the Local Government Code shall enact ordinances, approve resolutions, and appropriate funds for the general welfare of the Province and its inhabitants and in the proper exercise of the corporate powers of the province shall:

1. Approve ordinances and pass resolutions necessary for an efficient and effective provincial government;
2. Generate and maximize the use of resources and revenues for the development plans programs, objectives, and priorities of the province as provided for under Section 18 of RA 7160, with particular attention to agro-industrial development and country-wide growth and progress;
3. Grant franchises, approve the issuance of permits or licenses, or enact ordinances levying taxes, fees, and charges upon such conditions and for such purposes intended to promote the general welfare of the inhabitants of the Province;
4. Approve ordinances that shall ensure the efficient and effective delivery of the basic services and facilities within Pangasinan;
5. Exercise such other powers and performs such other duties and functions as may be prescribed by law or ordinance.

View Chart

PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR'S OFFICE

This is the office of the chief executive of the provincial government. It takes under its general supervision all offices of the executive branch through the Provincial Administrator. It has a direct supervision to the PGO Staff who is a mixture of permanent organic, detailed and co-terminus employees.

This Office is headed by the Provincial Governor himself who is an elected official.

DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS

The provincial governor, as the chief executive of the provincial government, exercises and performs the following powers and functions:

Exercise general supervision and control over all programs, projects, services, and activities of the provincial government;

Enforce all laws and ordinances relative to the governance of the province and exercise the appropriate corporate powers, implement all approved policies, programs, projects, services and activities of the province;

Initiate and maximize the generation of resources and revenues, and apply the same to the implementation of development plans, program objectives and priorities, particularly those resources and revenues programmed for agro-industrial development and country-wide growth and progress;

Ensure the delivery of basic services and the provision of adequate facilities; and

Exercise such other powers and perform such other duties and functions as may be prescribed by law or ordinance.

MANDATES AND FUNCTIONS

The Provincial Governor's Office serves as the primary overseer of all the executive departments & offices in the Provincial Capitol. The major functions are the following:

Acts as backbone of the Governor in providing globally-competitive, effective and efficient delivery of basic services to the public;

Provides aid to indigents, NGOs, and other local government units through medical, public infrastructure and financial assistance;

Coordinates with local, national and foreign agencies, media outfits and the private sector for appointments and other communication requirements to and from the Governor;

As a team, works in ensuring special support services to the Governor through an effective security force and executive assistance.

Coordinates with other departments of the provincial government for matters/documents requiring the Governor's approval.

PROGRAMS AND SERVICES

Provision of medicine aid, wheelchairs, eyeglasses and other medical equipment (nebulizer, crutches, etc.) to poor but deserving Surigaonons;

Provision of medical and laboratory work ups such as CT Scan, endoscopy, ultrasound, etc;

Provision of referrals to hospitals and social services institution;

Approval of requests for financial assistance on matters such as hospitalization, burial, medication requiring protocol treatment, transportation assistance, drug rehabilitation, etc.

Monitors the receiving, inspection and releasing of financial documents for Governor's signature (Vouchers, Payroll, Checks, POs of various departments and agencies);

Manages vouchers for Governor's approval (preparation, processing of vouchers for meals, flowers, supplies, telephone billings and other financial documents - internal to PGO-Staff);

Monitors the receiving, inspection and releasing of financial documents for Governor's signature (aid to indigents: medical and various donations, non medical)

Receives, reviews and releases documents for Governor's signature (MOA, Memoranda, Communications, Permits, Resolutions, Certificates, etc.);

Receives and Manages Internal Documents / Concerns for corresponding action or notation;

Monitors the preparation or drafting of correspondence including but not limited to letter, referral, recommendation, endorsement, and other official communications;

Monitors the receiving/drafting of the following documents: Messages of the Governor, Speeches of the Governor, Executive Order, Oath of Office/Certificates, Authority to Travel, etc.;

Monitors, reviews and updates the tracking number of PGO-Memo

Monitors and manages appointments/invitations of the Governor;

Facilitation of meeting to discuss and/or resolve official matter or concern of the management;

Leads in the facilitation of special events or projects relative to management;

Assists in the facilitation of Lakbay Aral Activities (Foreign and Local Visitors of the Province);

The Province of Surigao del Sur is often visited by visitors from all over the country and abroad to witness the various successful programs, reforms in the government and tourist attractions in the province. This office serves as the coordinating agency for these visits specifically the scheduling and approval of the Governor;

Ensuring the Security of the Governor.

 

Granting of Aid to Groups and Individuals

- As Local Chief Executive, the Governor extends assistance to groups and individuals in the province in the area of community and sports development. Financial/material assistance is granted to projects and undertakings that promote the interest of the greater majority.

 

Facilitating the Provision of Social Services

- In partnership with the Provincial Social Welfare and Development Office (PSWDO), the PGO Staff is tasked to facilitate social services delivery through the following functions:

 

Management of Financial Transaction

Provision of Administrative and Technical Support to the Governor

 

Special Projects

PGO-Staff is also involved from time to time, in Special Projects of the Provincial Government particularly in unprogrammed activities and events. The support extended is mostly coordinative.

SEKILAS DPRD PROVINSI KALIMANTAN UTARA

Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah (DPRD) Provinsi merupakan lembaga perwakilan rakyat daerah yang memiliki peran strategis dalam penyelenggaraan pemerintahan daerah. DPRD berfungsi sebagai mitra pemerintah daerah sekaligus sebagai pengawas jalannya kebijakan yang diambil oleh kepala daerah.

 

Sebagai representasi masyarakat, DPRD memastikan bahwa aspirasi publik tidak hanya menjadi wacana, tetapi benar-benar masuk ke dalam proses perumusan kebijakan daerah. DPRD menjadi jembatan antara pemerintah dan masyarakat dalam mewujudkan pembangunan yang adil dan merata.

 

Dalam sistem pemerintahan daerah, DPRD memiliki posisi penting dalam menjaga keseimbangan kekuasaan (check and balances). Setiap kebijakan strategis daerah, termasuk anggaran dan peraturan daerah, tidak dapat dijalankan tanpa persetujuan DPRD.

Dengan demikian, DPRD berperan sebagai penyambung lidah rakyat yang memastikan bahwa kebijakan pemerintah daerah tetap berada pada jalur kepentingan publik.
